agents.name: n8n Credential Unlocker
agents.description: Audits inactive n8n workflows, maps them to blocked credentials, and outputs a prioritized re-auth sequence with dependency order.

agents.name: Base44 Bearer Rotator
agents.description: Monitors Base44 token age across n8n workflows, generates a rotation plan, and logs the event to the Supabase credential_rotation_log table.

agents.name: SCH-02 Lane Field Patcher
agents.description: Diagnoses the missing SCH-02 lane field in Base44, generates the entity patch JSON, and outputs the n8n node mapping fix to unblock the stuck workflow lane.

agents.name: Dead Letter Queue Triager
agents.description: Reads the Supabase dead_letter_queue table, classifies errors by type, maps each to its originating n8n workflow, and writes a triage summary to dlq_triage_log.

agents.name: Wix Velo 500 Debugger
agents.description: Investigates the Wix Dev Mode/Velo 500 error on FlashFusion (Site ID 4cad8458-937c-4a7a-8936-2a670f2883fd), outputs root cause, fix plan, and rollback steps.

agents.name: Ticket Triage Agent
agents.description: Reads incoming support tickets, classifies severity and category, pulls matching KB articles, and outputs escalation path and a first-response draft.

agents.name: KB Article Generator
agents.description: Converts resolved ticket resolution notes into a formatted INT-brand KB article and saves it to the Google Drive KB folder.

agents.name: SLA Breach Monitor
agents.description: Scans the open ticket queue for SLA threshold violations and posts prioritized alerts to the Slack service-desk channel.

agents.name: Incident Timeline Builder
agents.description: Reconstructs a chronological incident timeline from Slack messages, Gmail threads, and ticket notes for use in post-mortems and client reports.

agents.name: Client Briefer
agents.description: Assembles a one-page brief for a named Intinc client before a support call — last 5 tickets, known issues, asset list, and open action items.

agents.name: Onboarding Doc Automator
agents.description: Takes a new Intinc client profile and generates a complete onboarding package — checklist, welcome doc, and asset intake form — saved to Google Drive.

agents.name: Client QBR Generator
agents.description: Pulls 90-day ticket history, resolution stats, and open issues for a named client and generates a formatted Quarterly Business Review document.

agents.name: n8n Workflow Auditor
agents.description: Reviews all n8n workflows for missing error handling, retry logic, credential gaps, and anti-patterns. Outputs a prioritized fix list.

agents.name: Workflow Doc Generator
agents.description: Reads an n8n workflow by ID or name and generates a human-readable Notion page with flow narrative, node inventory, trigger conditions, and failure modes.

agents.name: Error Handler Patcher
agents.description: Identifies n8n workflows missing error handling nodes and generates standardized error-catch + Supabase-log patterns as ready-to-import workflow JSON patches.

agents.name: Morning Briefing Builder
agents.description: Completes the blocked Morning Briefing workflow (05) — generates the Gmail node configuration that the n8n MCP SDK limitation prevented, as ready-to-import JSON.

agents.name: Workflow Activation Sequencer
agents.description: Analyzes the 11 blocked n8n workflows and outputs a dependency-ordered activation sequence that avoids credential and data race conditions.

agents.name: Entity Schema Builder
agents.description: Takes a plain-English entity description and generates a compliant Base44 entity JSON with typed fields, validations, defaults, and relationships.

agents.name: Fusion AI Session Monitor
agents.description: Polls active Base44/Fusion AI agent sessions, flags stuck or anomalously long-running sessions, and outputs intervention recommendations.

agents.name: Agent Definition Auditor
agents.description: Reviews all Fusion AI agent definitions against the current Base44 platform spec, flags stale configurations, missing tools, and deprecated fields.

agents.name: Base44 API Wrapper Generator
agents.description: Given a Base44 entity name, generates a production-ready TypeScript fetch wrapper with Bearer auth, error handling, retry logic, and type definitions.

agents.name: Store Completeness Auditor
agents.description: Checks all FlashFusion store products and collections for missing SEO fields, images, descriptions, and pricing. Outputs a gap report sorted by impact.

agents.name: Product Description Writer
agents.description: Takes a FlashFusion product name and specs and writes SEO-optimized product descriptions in brand voice, ready to paste into Wix.

agents.name: Order Comms Agent
agents.description: Handles the FlashFusion order lifecycle email pipeline — order confirmation, production update, shipping notification, and post-sale follow-up via Wix order events.

agents.name: Shipping Bug Documenter
agents.description: Reproduces the FlashFusion Basic Shipping API bug, captures the full request/response cycle, and outputs a Wix support ticket and an internal workaround document.

agents.name: PR Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews pull requests against the Maintainability > Correctness > Security > Observability priority order, outputs structured review comments and a pass/fail verdict.

agents.name: Dependency Auditor
agents.description: Scans all repos for outdated, vulnerable, and abandoned npm/pip packages. Outputs a prioritized update list with CVE links and migration notes.

agents.name: Secret Scanner
agents.description: Scans repository files and git history for accidentally committed API keys, tokens, connection strings, and service_role keys. Outputs findings with remediation steps.

agents.name: Repo Structure Auditor
agents.description: Checks repository structure against organizing-projects standards — naming conventions, file placement, dead code, and structural debt. Outputs violations and a refactor plan.

agents.name: Supabase Schema Auditor
agents.description: Reviews Supabase tables, RLS policies, indexes, and foreign keys across all projects for correctness, security gaps, and performance issues.

agents.name: Audit Log Analyzer
agents.description: Reads Supabase audit log tables, surfaces anomaly patterns (high error rates, unusual actors, schema changes), and generates a weekly summary with flagged events.

agents.name: RLS Policy Generator
agents.description: Takes a plain-English access rule and generates valid Supabase Row Level Security SQL with CREATE POLICY statements and verification test queries.

agents.name: Morning Briefing Agent
agents.description: Assembles a structured daily brief from Gmail priority inbox, Google Calendar, n8n error queue, and Supabase DLQ count. Runs each weekday morning.

agents.name: Weekly Review Agent
agents.description: Aggregates completed work across Linear, Notion tasks, n8n workflow runs, and Gmail threads into a structured weekly summary for review and planning.

agents.name: Subscription Audit Agent
agents.description: Sweeps Gmail for subscription receipts and billing emails, identifies active vendors, payment failures, and upcoming renewals, outputs a prioritized action list.

agents.name: Google Drive Classifier
agents.description: Runs the Drive Automation Chain on unclassified Google Drive files — classifies by type, routes to correct folder, and writes an audit record to Supabase.

agents.name: Memoir Source Miner
agents.description: Searches Google Drive for memoir-relevant source material — journals, notes, old writing — and surfaces themes, fragments, and narrative threads organized by life era.

agents.name: Post Draft Agent
agents.description: Converts a raw idea, bullet list, or topic into a platform-optimized LinkedIn, Threads, or X post in Kyle's voice — confident, specific, grounded in real experience.

agents.name: PostHog Error Triager
agents.description: Surfaces new PostHog error clusters from the last 24h, assigns priority by user impact, and cross-references with Supabase tables and recent GitLab commits.

agents.name: Token Expiry Watchdog
agents.description: Tracks API token ages across all connected services, flags tokens expiring within 7 days, outputs a rotation calendar, and posts alerts to Slack.
